text: OMP is a brand of Racing Force Group (Racing Force S.p.A.), the motorsport safety equipment company listed on Euronext Growth Milan; Euronext's listing announcement states that all products of the Group are marketed under OMP, Bell Helmets, ZeroNoise and Racing Spirit brands.
short: OMP is the brand of Racing Force S.p.A., listed on Euronext Growth Milan.

source.name: Euronext: 'Racing Force S.p.A. lists on Euronext Growth Milan' (press release)
source.quote: All products of the Group are marketed under OMP, Bell Helmets, ZeroNoise and Racing Spirit brands.
